answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 183137 Country: Kenya Title: Slaughtering Question: Is a Muslim adult lady allowed to slaughter an animal on behalf of a man? Answer ID: 183137 Posted on: Oct 31, 2021 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 302/242/B=3/1443) A woman can slaughter the animal if she has permission from the man. Animal slaughtered by her is also valid. It is necessary to slaughter by saying Bismillah Allahu Akbar. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
